about: Each state's water quality standards for its warm-water fish class (or its closest general one), plus EPA's national recommended criteria as the fallback. Built by scripts/make_standards.py from data/standards.csv.

epa.name: EPA national recommended criteria (fallback)
epa.useClass: Freshwater aquatic life, warmwater criteria, other life stages (EPA Quality Criteria for Water 1986 'Gold Book'; DO from EPA 440/5-86-003)
epa.citation: EPA National Recommended Water Quality Criteria - Aquatic Life Criteria Table (rows 'Oxygen, Dissolved Freshwater', 'pH', 'Solids Suspended and Turbidity'; page updated June 9, 2026), which refer to Quality Criteria for Water 1986 (Gold Book, EPA 440/5-86-001): DO Table 1 (PDF p. 216), pH (PDF p. 233), solids and turbidity (PDF p. 268)

Alaska.name: Alaska
Alaska.useClass: Fresh water use (C): growth and propagation of fish, shellfish, other aquatic life, and wildlife (Alaska has no warm-water class)
Alaska.citation: 18 AAC 70.020(b), fresh water parameters (3) dissolved gas, (6) pH, (12) turbidity, use (C) (am. 4/26/2024)

Alabama.name: Alabama
Alabama.useClass: Fish and Wildlife (F&W): 'diversified warm water biota, including game fish'
Alabama.citation: Ala. Admin. Code r. 335-6-10-.09(5)(e)2, 4, 9 (Fish and Wildlife); latest amendment eff. 6/14/2025

Arkansas.name: Arkansas
Arkansas.useClass: Aquatic life (fisheries) use: streams by ecoregion and watershed size; lakes and reservoirs
Arkansas.citation: 8 CAR 21-503 (turbidity), 21-504 (pH), 21-505 (dissolved oxygen) = APC&EC Rule 2 renamed 8 CAR Part 21; final text approved by APC&EC April 25, 2025

Arizona.name: Arizona
Arizona.citation: Ariz. Admin. Code R18-11-109(B) pH, (D) suspended sediment, (E) dissolved oxygen (eff. 9/10/2019)

California.name: California
California.useClass: No statewide class: WARM (Warm Freshwater Habitat) beneficial use, set separately in each of the 9 Regional Water Quality Control Board basin plans
California.citation: Regional Water Quality Control Plans (Basin Plans) of Regions 1-9 (Cal. Water Code 13240); statewide plans (Ocean Plan, ISWEBE Plan, Thermal Plan, Bay-Delta Plan) have no inland DO/pH/turbidity objectives

Colorado.name: Colorado
Colorado.useClass: Aquatic Life Class 1 Warm Water Biota (Table I)
Colorado.citation: 5 CCR 1002-31 (Regulation No. 31), section 31.16 Table I and footnotes 1, 3, 4, 9 (version effective Nov 25, 2024)

Connecticut.name: Connecticut
Connecticut.useClass: Class B inland surface waters (habitat for fish/aquatic life, recreation). Unclassified waters default to Class A, which has the same DO but pH 'as naturally occurs'
Connecticut.citation: RCSA §22a-426-9(a)(1), Table 1 (Surface Water Criteria by Classification); CT Water Quality Standards eff. Oct 10, 2013 (DEEP compilation revised 2015-11-21)

District of Columbia.name: District of Columbia
District of Columbia.useClass: Class C (protection and propagation of fish, shellfish and wildlife), non-tidal waters
District of Columbia.citation: 21 DCMR §1104.8, Table 1 (Conventional Constituents Numeric Criteria); section 1104 effective 3/14/2025

Delaware.name: Delaware
Delaware.useClass: Fresh waters (statewide criteria for all fresh waters; general aquatic life)
Delaware.citation: 7 Del. Admin. Code 7401 (Surface Water Quality Standards) §4.5.2.1, §4.5.2.3, §4.5.3.1, §4.5.5; last amended 26 DE Reg. 608 (eff. 1/1/2023)

Florida.name: Florida
Florida.useClass: Class III predominantly fresh waters (fish consumption; recreation; propagation and maintenance of a healthy, well-balanced population of fish and wildlife)
Florida.citation: Fla. Admin. Code R. 62-302.530(52)(c) pH and (70) turbidity; R. 62-302.533(1) DO (chapter 62-302 as posted by EPA, effective March 24, 2026)

Georgia.name: Georgia
Georgia.useClass: Fishing (propagation of fish, shellfish, game and other aquatic life), waters supporting warm water species of fish
Georgia.citation: Ga. Comp. R. & Regs. 391-3-6-.03(5)(c)-(d) turbidity, (6)(c)(ii) DO, (6)(c)(iii) pH (adopted Jan 28, 2022; EPA-approved Aug 31, 2022)

Hawaii.name: Hawaii
Hawaii.useClass: Inland waters: streams (HAR 11-54-5.2(b)); natural freshwater lakes and reservoirs get only the narrative basic criteria

Iowa.name: Iowa
Iowa.useClass: Class B(WW-1) warm water aquatic life type 1 (default for all perennial rivers/streams not otherwise listed); B(LW) lakes and wetlands same DO
Iowa.citation: Iowa Admin. Code r. 567-61.3(2)f, 61.3(3)b(1)-(2) and Table 2 (IAC 2/5/25)

Idaho.name: Idaho
Idaho.useClass: Warm water aquatic life (IDAPA 58.01.02.250.04); note Idaho presumes most waters support COLD water aquatic life
Idaho.citation: IDAPA 58.01.02.250.01.a (pH), 250.02.a and .e (cold DO, turbidity), 250.04.a (warm DO); 101.01.a (cold-water presumption)

Illinois.name: Illinois
Illinois.useClass: General use waters (statewide default; not Lake Michigan basin, not Chicago Area Waterway System)
Illinois.citation: 35 Ill. Adm. Code 302.206 (DO), 302.204 (pH), 302.203 (turbidity narrative); amended 47 Ill. Reg. 4437, eff. March 23, 2023

Indiana.name: Indiana
Indiana.useClass: All surface waters outside mixing zones, 'well-balanced aquatic community' (327 IAC 2-1-6(b)); warm-water default

Kansas.name: Kansas
Kansas.useClass: Aquatic life support use (special, expected and restricted all identical), non-thermally stratified surface waters
Kansas.citation: K.A.R. 28-16-28e(b)(8), (e) (amended 2022+), adopting KDHE 'Kansas surface water quality standards: tables of numeric criteria' dated July 1, 2023, Table 1g

Kentucky.name: Kentucky
Kentucky.citation: 401 KAR 10:031 Section 4(1)(b) pH, 4(1)(e) DO, 4(2)(a) cold water; Section 2(1)(c) turbidity; eff. 1-3-2020

Louisiana.name: Louisiana
Louisiana.useClass: Fish and wildlife propagation, fresh warmwater biota (statewide fresh-water criteria)

Massachusetts.name: Massachusetts
Massachusetts.useClass: Class B inland waters, warm water fishery
Massachusetts.citation: 314 CMR 4.05(3)(b)1., 3. and 6. (Massachusetts Surface Water Quality Standards, as amended eff. 11/12/2021)

Maryland.name: Maryland
Maryland.useClass: Use I (Class I): Water Contact Recreation and Protection of Nontidal Warmwater Aquatic Life

Maine.name: Maine
Maine.useClass: Class B fresh surface waters (common general river class). Lakes/ponds are Class GPA (no numeric DO); many minor drainages are Class C

Michigan.name: Michigan
Michigan.useClass: Warmwater fish and other aquatic life (all inland waters not designated coldwater); inland lakes per R 323.1065(2)

Minnesota.name: Minnesota
Minnesota.useClass: Class 2B (cool and warm water aquatic life and habitat)
Minnesota.citation: Minn. R. 7050.0222, subp. 4 (class 2B) and subp. 2 (class 2A); published electronically July 20, 2023

Missouri.name: Missouri
Missouri.citation: 10 CSR 20-7.031(5)(E), (5)(G), (5)(J) and Table A1 (Code of State Regulations 9/30/23; last amended eff. Feb 28, 2022)

Mississippi.name: Mississippi
Mississippi.useClass: Fish and Wildlife (default classification for all surface waters)
Mississippi.citation: 11 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 6, R. 2.2.A(3) (turbidity), 2.2.C (DO), 2.2.D (pH); amended 9/3/2021

Montana.name: Montana
Montana.useClass: B-3 (warm water: growth and propagation of non-salmonid fishes); most Montana waters are B-1/A-1 (cold)

North Carolina.name: North Carolina
North Carolina.useClass: Class C (aquatic life propagation and survival; applies to all freshwaters at minimum), non-trout waters
North Carolina.citation: 15A NCAC 02B .0211(6) DO, (14) pH, (21) turbidity (readopted eff. Nov 1, 2019; amended eff. June 1 and Sept 1, 2022)

North Dakota.name: North Dakota
North Dakota.useClass: Class I/IA streams and all classified lakes/reservoirs (lakes use class I stream criteria, incl. class 3 warm water fishery lakes)
North Dakota.citation: N.D. Admin. Code 33.1-16-02.1-09(3) and Table 1 (eff. Jan 1, 2019; amended Jan 1, 2024)

Nebraska.name: Nebraska
Nebraska.useClass: Warmwater aquatic life, Class A and Class B (identical DO criteria)
Nebraska.citation: Title 117 NAC Ch. 4, 003.01A (pH), 003.04C1/003.04D1 (warmwater DO), 005 (aesthetics); state copy effective June 24, 2019 (EPA posting Sept 5, 2023 says in effect for CWA purposes)

New Jersey.name: New Jersey
New Jersey.citation: N.J.A.C. 7:9B-1.14(d)2, 5 and 13 (re-adopted July 17, 2023; last amended Dec 18, 2023)

Nevada.name: Nevada
Nevada.useClass: No statewide numeric class: criteria are set per control point / water body (NAC 445A.1242-445A.2234)

New York.name: New York
New York.useClass: Classes AA, A, B, C (fresh surface waters suitable for fish propagation and survival), non-trout waters

Ohio.name: Ohio
Ohio.useClass: Warmwater habitat (WWH), the default for streams without an assigned aquatic life use
Ohio.citation: Ohio Adm. Code 3745-1-35, Table 35-1 (eff. Feb 6, 2017); use designations in 3745-1-07(B)(1) (eff. April 4, 2024)

Oklahoma.name: Oklahoma
Oklahoma.useClass: Fish and Wildlife Propagation - Warm Water Aquatic Community (WWAC)
Oklahoma.citation: Okla. Admin. Code 252:730-5-12(f)(1) DO, (f)(3) pH, (f)(7) turbidity + Appendix G Table 1; amended eff. 9/15/2024 (formerly OAC 785:45-5-12, revoked 8/11/2023)

Oregon.name: Oregon
Oregon.useClass: Warm-water aquatic life (OAR 340-041-0016(4)); most Oregon waters are designated cold-water or cool-water

Pennsylvania.name: Pennsylvania
Pennsylvania.useClass: WWF (Warm Water Fishes), a statewide aquatic life use under 25 Pa. Code §93.4 Table 2 unless a more protective use (CWF, TSF, HQ/EV) is designated
Pennsylvania.citation: 25 Pa. Code §93.7(a), Table 3 (amended Dec 19, 2025, eff. Dec 20, 2025, 55 Pa.B. 8596)

Rhode Island.name: Rhode Island
Rhode Island.useClass: Class B / B1 freshwaters, Warm Water Fish Habitat
Rhode Island.citation: 250-RICR-150-05-1 §1.10(D)(1) (Class Specific Criteria - Freshwaters table); version effective Jan 13, 2026

South Carolina.name: South Carolina
South Carolina.citation: S.C. Code Ann. Regs. 61-68.G.10 (Freshwaters), items e, g, i; SCDES copy incl. State Register amendments through May 23, 2025

South Dakota.name: South Dakota
South Dakota.useClass: Warmwater permanent fish life propagation waters (beneficial use 4)
South Dakota.citation: ARSD 74:51:01:47 (warmwater permanent; 47 SDR 110, eff. April 27, 2021) and 74:51:01:45 (coldwater permanent)

Tennessee.name: Tennessee
Tennessee.citation: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 0400-40-03-.03(3)(a) DO, (b) pH, (d) turbidity; amendments eff. 3/17/2024

Texas.name: Texas
Texas.useClass: High aquatic life use (presumed for perennial streams, rivers and lakes not listed in Appendix A or D; Texas has no 'warm-water' class)
Texas.citation: 30 TAC 307.4(h)(3) presumed high ALU; 307.7(b)(3)(A) Table 3 DO; 307.4(m) pH narrative + 307.10 Appendix A segment pH; 307.4(b)(5) turbidity (2022 Texas SWQS, effective for CWA purposes June 27, 2025)

Utah.name: Utah
Utah.useClass: Class 3B: protected for warm water species of game fish and other warm water aquatic life
Utah.citation: Utah Admin. Code R317-2-14, Table 2.14.2 and footnotes (2), (2a) (am. eff. 1/25/2023)

Virginia.name: Virginia
Virginia.useClass: Class III - Nontidal Waters (Coastal and Piedmont Zones), aquatic life
Virginia.citation: 9VAC25-260-50 (Class III), amended eff. April 18, 2023; turbidity narrative 9VAC25-260-20

Vermont.name: Vermont
Vermont.useClass: Warm Water Fish Habitat (waters listed in App. A §A-01), Class B(2). Note: all unlisted waters are Cold Water Fish Habitat by default
Vermont.citation: Vermont Water Quality Standards, Environmental Protection Rule Ch. 29A, §29A-302(4)-(5), §29A-303(6), App. A §A-01/§A-02 (version effective March 5, 2024, as posted by EPA Aug 2024)

Washington.name: Washington
Washington.useClass: Indigenous warm water species (WAC 173-201A-200(1)(a)(vi)); most Washington waters carry salmonid/char uses

Wisconsin.name: Wisconsin
Wisconsin.useClass: Fish and aquatic life, warm water default (NR 102.04(4))
Wisconsin.citation: Wis. Admin. Code NR 102.04(4)(a)2.-3., (4)(c) (current code, docs.legis.wisconsin.gov)

West Virginia.name: West Virginia
West Virginia.useClass: Category B1 - Warm water fishery streams (propagation and maintenance of fish and other aquatic life)
West Virginia.citation: W. Va. Code R. 47CSR2, Appendix E, Table 1, items 8.12 (DO), 8.24 (pH), 8.33 (turbidity); rule effective 7/1/2026 (final filing 3/4/2026)

Wyoming.name: Wyoming
Wyoming.useClass: Warmwater aquatic life (WWQR Ch. 1, 2025 version; replaces old classes 2AB/2B/2C)
Wyoming.citation: Wyoming Water Quality Rules Ch. 1 (020.0011.1.08062025, eff. 08/06/2025), Sec. 15(e),(h); Sec. 16(e), 16(g) Table 3
